fact: A World Bank implementation support mission of 8-12 September 2025 planned the mass registration of the population on the new digital identity platform for January or February 2026, jointly with the single social registry update, with a systems integrator designing the new foundational ID with INIC and DGRN.
title: Missão de Apoio a Implementação para o Projecto Digital São Tomé e Príncipe: Ajuda Memória
